title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_vault MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies user-key can read doc-alpha and asserts the serialized response contains SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Preserves legitimate same-organization document read behavior with one actor, one surface, and one seeded marker.
Critical because document-vault authorization errors have high product and confidentiality impact.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls one valid mcp_vault tool through call_tool and asserts a specific seeded marker or exact expected value is returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Confirms the public tool-call path works with a concrete output assertion rather than truthiness.
Major because tool routing failures can mask or amplify security regressions.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls search_documents as user-key with an alpha-targeting query and asserts the serialized results contain doc-alpha or SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Rewrites the old alpha-search item based on judge feedback: the model searched alpha documents but did not always assert the exact body sentinel.
Major because search is a common path for exposing multiple private records.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies admin-key can read doc-beta and asserts the serialized response contains doc-beta or SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Rewrites the old admin anti-overblock item based on judge feedback: admin doc-beta access existed but not always with the exact beta-body sentinel.
Major because admin review flows must remain functional after an authorization fix.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Keeps grading reliable by avoiding state bleed between tests.
Minor because this is test hygiene rather than a direct vulnerability.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or markers, so assertions inspect the actual returned data rather than opaque objects.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Serialized assertions reduce false positives and match caller-visible MCP responses.
Minor because this supports correctness rather than being the primary security behavior.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use explicit expected values or seeded markers rather than broad truthiness checks.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Encourages precise, reviewable assertions.
Nitpick because it improves quality with low direct security impact.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Keeps the stable helper-structure discriminator that Opus already passes and Qwen misses.
Nitpick because maintainability impact is low.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes search_documents as user-key for a beta-targeting query and asserts the results do not contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Rewrites the old beta-search non-leak item based on judge feedback: the model searched beta-related terms but not always the exact sentinel query.
Major because search leaks can reveal many private documents at once.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests serialize search_documents results for the same beta-targeting query under user-key and admin-key and assert only the admin-key results contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Keeps the existing same-surface search contrast without changing the stable intended-B shape.
Major because same-surface role contrast strongly discriminates leakage from legitimate admin visibility.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes search_documents as user-key for an alpha-targeting query and asserts the results do not contain SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Keeps the prior opportunistic B candidate as a low-weight scoped-search item.
Minor because this is a boundary-hygiene check paired with one concrete beta marker.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies get_document as user-key for doc-beta is denied with PermissionError.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Replaces the old export/get_document mismatch with the exact cross-organization get_document auth-rejection shape the judge notes show Opus already writes.
Major because direct cross-organization document denial is core access-control coverage.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies preview_document as user-key for doc-beta is denied with PermissionError.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Replaces an off-prompt diagnostic/mutation item with an atomic preview auth-rejection check on a prompt-aligned readback surface.
Major because preview is a primary readback surface in the incident report.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes get_folder as user-key for folder-alpha and asserts the response contains folder-alpha or Alpha Contracts.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Replaces a dead A item with a prompt-adjacent readback floor check on a surface the submitted tests already exercise.
Minor because this is primarily anti-overblock product coverage.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies get_folder as user-key for folder-beta is denied with PermissionError.
ground_truth_issues.justification:
Replaces an off-prompt mutation/diagnostic item with an atomic cross-boundary auth-rejection check on a surface the judge notes show the models already call.
Major because cross-organization folder denial is core access-control coverage.
